description: A first-order theory \(T\) has a universal axiomatization if and only if it is preserved under nonempty substructures.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.substructure_preserved_iff_universal.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : L.Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.SubstructurePreserved T ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.HasUniversalAxiomatization T
